name: Reddit
pitch_then: Users submit links and vote them up or down to build a ranked front page of the web.
became: Sold to Condé Nast 2006; spun out, IPO on NYSE in March 2024.

name: Scribd
pitch_then: A YouTube-style site where anyone uploads and shares documents, publishing them to the web.
became: Grew into a document and ebook subscription library; still independent, no reported valuation.

name: OMGPop
pitch_then: An independent studio making casual multiplayer Flash games that people play in the browser.
became: Hit with Draw Something; bought by Zynga for about $180M in 2012, then shut.

name: Dropbox
pitch_then: A folder on your computer that automatically syncs your files across all your machines and the web.
became: Became the default file-sharing tool; IPO in March 2018 at about $12B.

name: Weebly
pitch_then: A drag-and-drop website builder so non-technical people can make their own sites.
became: Acquired by Square for about $365M in 2018.

name: Twitch
pitch_then: Broadcast a founder's whole life live, 24/7, from a camera worn on a baseball cap.
became: Pivoted from lifecasting to game streaming; Amazon bought it for $970M in 2014.

name: Machine Zone
pitch_then: Build social multiplayer games for mobile phones, when most phone games were solo.
became: Made Game of War; AppLovin took it over for about $329M in 2020.

name: Heroku
pitch_then: A browser-based editor for building Ruby on Rails web apps, later hosting them in the cloud.
became: Became a cloud app platform; Salesforce bought it for $212M in 2010.

name: WePay
pitch_then: Easy online payments for groups that need to collect money together, like clubs and events.
became: Became an API payments company for platforms; JPMorgan bought it for a reported $400M in 2017.

name: Mixpanel
pitch_then: Track what users do inside web and mobile apps with event-based analytics for startups.
became: Grew into a leading product analytics company; valued about $865M in 2021 round.

name: Presto
pitch_then: Tabletop tablets that let restaurant diners order and pay from their seat.
became: Went public via SPAC in 2022 at $525M pre-money; later delisted.

name: FutureAdvisor
pitch_then: Online service that reviews your investment accounts and gives automated, personalized portfolio advice.
became: BlackRock bought it for a reported $150M in 2015.

name: Docker
pitch_then: A platform for deploying web apps in many programming languages without managing servers.
became: Pivoted to container tooling; valued about $2.1B in 2022 Series C.

name: inDinero
pitch_then: Online bookkeeping and a financial dashboard that shows small business owners where their money goes.
became: Still operating, now focused on accounting services; no reported valuation.

name: PagerDuty
pitch_then: Alert on-call engineers by phone and text when servers break, and escalate until someone responds.
became: IPO on NYSE in April 2019, valued about $2.8B on day one.

name: Optimizely
pitch_then: Let marketers run A/B tests on their websites with a visual editor and no code.
became: Sold its web business to Episerver in 2020; the combined company took the Optimizely name.

name: Apollo
pitch_then: An open-source framework for building real-time web apps entirely in JavaScript.
became: Pivoted to GraphQL tooling; raised about $183M, valuation not reported.

name: HackerRank
pitch_then: Programming challenges that let employers screen engineering candidates by skill instead of resume.
became: Grew into a developer hiring platform; no reported valuation.

name: OneSignal
pitch_then: A free push notification service for mobile app developers.
became: Grew into a customer messaging platform; no reported valuation.

name: Codecademy
pitch_then: Free interactive lessons that teach you to code right in the browser.
became: Skillsoft bought it for $525M in 2022.

name: Segment
pitch_then: A classroom tool where students ask questions and give feedback during lectures.
became: Pivoted to customer data infrastructure; Twilio bought it for $3.2B in 2020.

name: Vidyard
pitch_then: Video hosting with viewer analytics, built for marketers.
became: Grew into a sales and marketing video platform; no reported valuation.

name: SingleStore
pitch_then: A very fast SQL database that keeps data in memory and compiles queries to machine code.
became: Vector Capital took a majority in a buyout reported near $500M in 2025.

name: HelloSign
pitch_then: Sign documents electronically from inside Gmail and Google Docs.
became: Dropbox bought it for $230M in 2019.

name: Tremendous
pitch_then: Send gift cards to friends by email, delivered instantly online.
became: Pivoted to business payouts and rewards; no reported valuation.

name: Fivestars
pitch_then: A loyalty rewards program for local shops, tracked by phone number or card swipe.
became: Acquired by SpotOn in 2022; price undisclosed.

name: GOAT Group
pitch_then: Dinner events that match strangers to eat together at local restaurants.
became: Pivoted to a sneaker marketplace; valued $3.7B in 2021.

name: DrChrono
pitch_then: Electronic health records that doctors use on an iPad.
became: Acquired by EverCommerce in 2021; price undisclosed.

name: PlanGrid
pitch_then: An iPad app that lets construction crews view blueprints on the job site.
became: Autodesk bought it for $875M in 2018.

name: Rescale
pitch_then: On-demand cloud supercomputing for engineers who run heavy simulations.
became: Still independent, now AI and HPC workloads; no reported valuation.

name: Gusto
pitch_then: Simple payroll for small businesses, with an API that pays employees and handles taxes.
became: Grew into an HR platform; valued about $9.3B in a 2025 tender.

name: Matterport
pitch_then: A 3D camera that scans building interiors into explorable digital models.
became: Went public via SPAC in 2021 at about $2.9B; CoStar bought it in 2025.

name: Amplitude
pitch_then: A speech-to-text app that turns voice messages into readable text.
became: Pivoted to product analytics; direct listing in September 2021 near $7B.

name: Sendwave
pitch_then: A mobile app for sending money abroad with no transfer fees.
became: Merged into WorldRemit in 2020 in a deal reported near $500M.

name: HealthSherpa
pitch_then: A private-sector site for comparing and enrolling in health insurance plans under the new health law.
became: Became a major ACA enrollment site; no reported valuation.

name: Clever
pitch_then: Single sign-on and data syncing so schools can connect classroom apps easily.
became: Kahoot bought it for $500M in 2021.

name: SmartAsset
pitch_then: Free personal finance calculators and content that help people make money decisions.
became: Became a marketplace matching consumers with financial advisors; no reported valuation.

name: Lever
pitch_then: Recruiting software that combines an applicant tracking system with a candidate CRM.
became: Acquired by Employ Inc. in 2022; price undisclosed.

name: Submittable
pitch_then: Online submission management for literary magazines that receive writing from many authors.
became: Expanded to grants and social impact programs; no reported valuation.

name: Zapier
pitch_then: Connect web apps to each other so tasks happen automatically, with no code.
became: Became a major automation platform; profitable, no verified valuation found.

name: Benchling
pitch_then: Cloud software for biologists to design DNA sequences and plan lab experiments.
became: Grew into biotech R&D cloud; valued $6.1B in 2021 round.

name: Plivo
pitch_then: A cloud API for developers to add phone calls and text messaging to apps.
became: Still independent, now voice AI agents; no reported valuation.

name: North
pitch_then: An armband that reads arm muscle signals so you can control devices with hand gestures.
became: Pivoted to smart glasses; Google bought it for a reported $180M in 2020.

name: Fivetran
pitch_then: Automated connectors that copy a company's app data into a warehouse for analysis.
became: Valued $5.6B in 2021; merged with dbt Labs in 2025.

name: InfluxData
pitch_then: A hosted service for monitoring metrics and events from servers and apps.
became: Open-sourced a time series database that became its main product; no reported valuation.

name: Heap
pitch_then: Analytics that records every click and tap automatically, with no tracking code to write.
became: Acquired by Contentsquare in 2023; price undisclosed.

name: CoreOS
pitch_then: A lightweight Linux operating system for server clusters that updates itself automatically.
became: Red Hat bought it for $250M in 2018.

name: Panorama Education
pitch_then: Surveys and analytics that let school districts hear from students, teachers and parents.
became: Grew into a K-12 data platform; no reported valuation.

name: Lob
pitch_then: An API that prints and mails letters and postcards on demand.
became: Still independent as a direct mail automation platform; no reported valuation.

name: Webflow
pitch_then: A visual design tool that lets designers build websites without writing code.
became: Valued $2.1B in 2021 Series C; may have since been valued higher.

name: AirHelp
pitch_then: Help air passengers claim compensation for delayed or cancelled flights.
became: Grew into a global claims service; no reported valuation.

name: Bellabeat
pitch_then: Stylish wearable jewelry that tracks activity, sleep and stress for women.
became: Still sells wellness wearables; no reported valuation.

name: Cambly
pitch_then: On-demand English tutors, reachable by video chat at any time.
became: Still independent online tutoring marketplace; no reported valuation.

name: Noora Health
pitch_then: Train patients' families in hospitals to give care skills after discharge, starting in India.
became: Nonprofit that scaled care training across Indian hospitals; no valuation.

name: MBX
pitch_then: Monthly boxes of Korean beauty products delivered by subscription.
became: Still operating as a beauty brand; no reported valuation.

name: Povio
pitch_then: A small studio building mobile and web apps for startups.
became: Still an engineering and design agency; no reported valuation.

name: Snapdocs
pitch_then: Digital mortgage closing, so signing documents is done online instead of on paper.
became: Grew into a mortgage closing platform; no verified valuation.
